title: Create sisters and brothers tuples
description:
Create a tuple containing names of your sisters and your brothers (imaginary siblings are fine).

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as create_siblings_tuples(sisters, brothers), where sisters and brothers are lists of names, returning a tuple (sisters_tuple, brothers_tuple) with each list converted to a tuple.
hints: You need to build two separate tuples here, one for sisters and one for brothers, then hand both back together.
The built-in tuple() function converts any list into a tuple with the same items in the same order.
Return (tuple(sisters), tuple(brothers)) - a tuple pairing the converted sisters tuple with the converted brothers tuple.
expected_behavior: Returns a 2-tuple of (sisters as a tuple, brothers as a tuple).
explanation: tuple() takes any iterable, such as a list, and produces a tuple with the same elements - applying it to both the sisters and brothers lists converts each into its own tuple.
